schemeScope: Combined Higher scheme LC001ALP000IV. PDF 1 the cover, 2 blank; PDF 3–5 Páipéar I Ceist 1 Ceapadóireacht (Ionramháil Ábhair 20 + Cumas Gaeilge 80, the examiner’s note, the Cumas Gaeilge definition, the 80-mark grade table on PDF 4 and the 20-mark Ábhar bands on PDF 5); PDF 5–6 the reading rules (Eolas + Ionramháil 2 + 1; P1 + P2 + Ionramháil 2 + 1 + 1) and passage A’s summary of tariffs; PDF 7–10 passage A’s key and its totals; PDF 10–11 passage B’s summary; PDF 11–14 passage B’s key and the Ceist 2 totals. PDF 15–19 belong to Páipéar II, PDF 20–24 to the aural test, PDF 25–28 are blank. No modified marking scheme is printed.
reviewMethod: Every paper page (1 cover, 2 the Treoracha, 3 the composition titles, 4–7 the passages and their questions, 8 blank) and scheme PDF 3–14 read in the text layer and checked against the rendered page; the passage pages are read by glyph position. Each prompt line and scheme slice is asserted against the PDFs by the builder, and every line of each part’s key goes to exactly one criterion.

nonPoolDecisions: Composition: one 100-mark card per printed title, A(a)–(c), B(a)–(b), C(a)–(b), D(a)–(b): 9 cards, criteria Ionramháil Ábhair 20 and Cumas Gaeilge 80 (quality, judged as one unit).
Reading: each of the 20 printed parts is a card, and each of the 10 printed questions a whole card carrying both parts’ criteria (7 marks).

A part’s criteria are the terms of the split the key prints for it: (2+1) Eolas 2 + Ionramháil 1; (2+1+1) P1 + P2 3 (a ladder, 2 then 3) + Ionramháil 1; “Pointe amháin(2+1)” as (2+1); “3 mharc gan ionramháil” one Eolas criterion at 3; A 3(b) “Dhá thréith =1+1” 2 + “céard is bun leis na tréithe” 2; A 5(b) “(2+2) gan ionramháil” Eachtra 2 + Míniú 2; B 1(b) “(2+1+1) (Eachtra+Míniú+Ionramháil)” Eachtra 2 + Míniú 1 + Ionramháil 1.

Rows: the answers quoted from the passage at the term’s price; answers the key prices itself at that price (“= 3 - 1 = 2 mharc”, “= 1 + 1 = 2 mharc”, “= 0”); the key’s own-words versions are samples. The Ionramháil criterion’s row is the key’s rule “Is ionann “ionramháil” agus …”, at 1.
Steps only where the key prints a split: “=1+1” (two traits, 0/1/2), “= 1 + 1 = 2 mharc” (Míniú, 0/1/2), a sentence of two points “= 2 + 1” (0/2/3). Nothing else steps.
The passage-level Gaeilge deduction “[Gaeilge lochtach: 0 - 3 a bhaint den iomlán a gnóthaíodh.]” (E(35) − Gge.(0-3)) is in every reading card’s note, never a criterion of one part.
sourceFindings: Pre-2012 layout: Páipéar 1 is composition and reading (170); the listening test is a separate component (LC001ALPA00IV) and Páipéar 2 is literature and Stair na Gaeilge.
Existing Atlas entries for this paper are section keys (R-A, R-B, W-A … W-D); the cards add R-A-1 … R-B-5, R-A-1-a … R-B-5-b and W-A-a … W-D-b beside them, the 2012 convention.
Paper misprints, carded as printed: B 5(b) “(Dhá pointe).” (the scheme “(Dhá phointe)”).

Scheme variants beside the paper (the cards show the paper’s question): A 2(b) restated without “(Alt 2)”; A 3(b) “muintir naPolainne” with no tariff after it; A 4(b) “Eoin Pól 11” for “II”; B 1(a) “Cé a bheidh” for “Cé a bheadh”; B 2(a) “David McWilliams” for “David Mc Williams”; B’s summary “Eachta óna huachtaránacht”.
The reading key prints the passage A rules on PDF 5–6 and each passage’s tariff summary before its key; neither summary is a card’s guidance.
Wingdings U+F0E0 on PDF 5 (the Ábhar band arrow) is repaired to →; SymbolMT bullets U+F0B7 to •.
